options.systemMessage:
You are a strict reviewer. Output ONLY valid JSON. No prose, no markdown.

Input is a JSON array of objects:
{ "q": string, "a": string }

Write a short overall summary of the answer quality.
Mention if answers look too short, generic, repetitive, copied, or unrelated.

Return exactly:
{
  "summary": string
}

Do not return passCount.
Do not return failCount.
Do not invent item counts.

INSERT INTO applicants (
  first_name, last_name, applicant_email, phone,
  country, state, city, linkedin_url,
  job_title, education, cv_filename, source,
  status, blacklisted, thread_id, message_id, applied_at
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $('ParseHubSpotForm').item.json.first_name }}',
  '{{ $('ParseHubSpotForm').item.json.last_name }}',
  '{{ $('ParseHubSpotForm').item.json.applicant_email }}',
  '{{ $('ParseHubSpotForm').item.json.phone }}',
  '{{ $('ParseHubSpotForm').item.json.country }}',
  '{{ $('ParseHubSpotForm').item.json.state }}',
  '{{ $('ParseHubSpotForm').item.json.city }}',
  '{{ $('ParseHubSpotForm').item.json.linkedin_url }}',
  '{{ $('ParseHubSpotForm').item.json.job_title }}',
  '{{ $('ParseHubSpotForm').item.json.education }}',
  '{{ $('ParseHubSpotForm').item.json.cv_filename }}',
  '{{ $('ParseHubSpotForm').item.json.source }}',
  'saturday_meeting',
  0,
  '{{ $json.threadId }}',
  '{{ $json.id }}',
  '{{ $json.received_at ? new Date($json.received_at).toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace("T", " ") : new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 19).replace("T", " ") }}'
)
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
  first_name      = VALUES(first_name),
  last_name       = VALUES(last_name),
  phone           = VALUES(phone),
  country         = VALUES(country),
  state           = VALUES(state),
  city            = VALUES(city),
  linkedin_url    = VALUES(linkedin_url),
  job_title       = VALUES(job_title),
  education       = VALUES(education),
  cv_filename     = VALUES(cv_filename),
  source          = VALUES(source),
  status          = 'new',
  blacklisted     = 0,
  thread_id       = VALUES(thread_id),
  message_id      = VALUES(message_id),
  applied_at      = VALUES(applied_at);
